summary: Implemented attempt log retention: the engine now rotates a ticket's existing raw log to its attempt-numbered name at spawn time before the new attempt writes, for both the implement log (<id>.log -> <id>.attempt-N.log) and the resolver log (<id>.resolver.log -> <id>.attempt-N.resolver.log), with N read from the ticket's events file so rotated names agree with attempt numbers. Added engine temp-pool tests covering a scripted re-run and a second resolver run, plus the resolver log rotation. Full suite (143 engine/server/fleet + 61 UI tests), tsc --noEmit, and vite build all pass.
